source_issue.title: Move videos from the User Manual to a CDN or YouTube

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue seeks to move videos and large assets from the Volto repository to a Content Delivery Network (CDN) or YouTube to reduce repository size and improve performance. Currently, these videos contribute to an unnecessary increase in disk usage, which could hinder development.

## What needs to be done
The primary tasks include migrating existing video files to an external host and updating all relevant documentation to reflect this change. The approach for hosting (YouTube vs. CDN) needs to be decided in coordination with multiple teams (Documentation, Admin, Marketing).

## Helpful background
Recent discussions highlighted that including large files in version control negatively impacts repository performance. Using tools like Git Large File Storage (LFS) or DVC (Data Version Control) can help manage large assets while keeping the repository lean.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the issue discussions and existing comments.
2. Engage with team members: Comment on this issue if you have insights or preferences about hosting options.
3. Consider learning about Git LFS or DVC if you’re interested in large file management in repositories.
4. Note that the complexity of this task makes it less suitable for new contributors, as it requires teamwork and coordination.
```
